verdict.rationale: xAI's REST reference states that its REST API is compatible with the OpenAI REST API, so existing OpenAI-compatible tooling can be pointed at it. Grok on Microsoft Foundry is also described as exposing an OpenAI-compatible API. The core of the story is documented, but the only migration guides in the pack cover model retirement, not moving from other providers. Missing for 10: a documented migration or adapter guide from other providers' SDKs (e.g. Anthropic SDK compatibility), explicit base-URL-swap instructions for the OpenAI SDK, and independent or hands-on corroboration of drop-in compatibility.
